approval_ref: Continue improving CIRP efficiency, accuracy and adaptability across RFI, Submittal and Email content.
notes: Reproduce an insulation-thickness unit accepted as the pipe-diameter unit inside one exact RFI citation.
Bind recognized number/unit, property/number/unit and workflow/property/number/unit relationships.
Accept allowlisted compact forms such as 2mm, 150MPa and 4L/s without treating arbitrary alphanumeric text as a measurement.
Normalize only formatting-equivalent inch and foot forms; never convert units.
Make no provider request, dependency, arithmetic or source-authority rule.
title: Ground numeric measurement units
objective: Prevent a recognized measurement unit from moving between numeric properties or exact workflow items in one project-file answer scope.
